arxiv-2110-06634.title: End-to-end translation of human neural activity to speech with a dual-dual generative adversarial network
arxiv-2110-06634.creator: Yina Guo, Xiaofei Zhang, Zhenying Gong, Anhong Wang and Wenwu Wang
arxiv-2110-06634.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yina Guo, Xiaofei Zhang, Zhenying Gong, Anhong Wang and Wenwu Wang. In a recent study of auditory evoked potential (AEP) based brain-computer interface (BCI), it was shown that, with an encoder-decoder framework, it is possible to translate human neural activity to speech (T-CAS). However, current encoder-decoder-based methods achieve T-CAS often with a two-step method where the information is passed between the encoder and decoder with a shared dimension reduction vector, which may result in a loss of information.

arxiv-2205-06486.title: A Survey of Left Atrial Appendage Segmentation and Analysis in 3D and 4D Medical Images Thanks: Supported in part by the Croatian Science Foundation under project UIP-2017-05-4968.
arxiv-2205-06486.creator: Hrvoje Leventić, Marin Benčević, Danilo Babin, Marija Habijan, Irena Galić
arxiv-2205-06486.description: Abstract Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a cardiovascular disease identified as one of the main risk factors for stroke. The majority of strokes due to AF are caused by clots originating in the left atrial appendage (LAA). LAA occlusion is an effective procedure for reducing stroke risk. Planning the procedure using pre-procedural imaging and analysis has shown benefits.

pmc-10585270.title: Knockout of CAFFEOYL-COA 3-O-METHYLTRANSFERASE 6/6L enhances the S/G ratio of lignin monomers and disease resistance in Nicotiana tabacum
pmc-10585270.creator: Mingxin Liu, Huayin Liu, Jianduo Zhang, Cui Li, Yinke Li, Guangyu Yang, Tong Xia, Haitao Huang, Yong Xu, Weisong Kong, Bingzhu Hou, Xiaoquan Qi, Jin Wang
pmc-10585270.description: Background Nicotiana tabacum is an important economic crop, which is widely planted in the world. Lignin is very important for maintaining the physiological and stress-resistant functions of tobacco. However, higher lignin content will produce lignin gas, which is not conducive to the formation of tobacco quality. To date, how to precisely fine-tune lignin content or composition remains unclear.

pmc-10671593.title: Transcriptome Profiling Provides Insights into the Early Development of Tiller Buds in High- and Low-Tillering Orchardgrass Genotypes
pmc-10671593.creator: Guangyan Feng, Xiaoheng Xu, Wen Liu, Feigxiang Hao, Zhongfu Yang, Gang Nie, Linkai Huang, Yan Peng, Shaun Bushman, Wei He, Xinquan Zhang, Abir U Igamberdiev
pmc-10671593.description: Orchardgrass (Dactylis glomerata L.) is among the most economically important perennial cool-season grasses, and is considered an excellent hay, pasture, and silage crop in temperate regions worldwide. Tillering is a vital feature that dominates orchardgrass regeneration and biomass yield. However, transcriptional dynamics underlying early-stage bud development in high- and low-tillering orchardgrass genotypes are unclear.

pmc-11531328.title: Schmorl's Node Mimicking Spinal Metastatic Disease: A Case Report and Review of the Literature
pmc-11531328.creator: Michael S Schallmo, Katherine D Drexelius, William A Ahrens, Joshua C Patt
pmc-11531328.description: In this report, we present a progressively enlarging, degenerative, intraspongious/intravertebral herniated nucleus pulposus, also referred to as a "Schmorl's node," in a 65-year-old patient with a history of prostate cancer. The patient initially presented to our orthopedic oncology clinic for the evaluation of lytic-appearing lesions involving the L4 and L5 vertebral bodies.

pmc-12586174.title: Public health economics and upstream income-based policies: from cost to value
pmc-12586174.creator: Neil McHugh, Rachel Baker, Verity Watson, Neil Craig, David Bomark, Clare Bambra, Victoria J. McGowan, Ruth Lightbody, Cam Donaldson
pmc-12586174.description: Upstream income-based policies are widely accepted by researchers as key levers to address health inequalities. However, scarce public resources mean difficult decisions about policy implementation must be clearly justified. A public mandate, through knowledge of public preferences, offers one route to transformative policy change.

pmc-12630996.title: Beyond the Brackets: A Case Report of Acute Angioedema Associated With Orthodontic Treatment
pmc-12630996.creator: Akansha Pandey, Ajit V Parihar, T P Chaturvedi, Dishant Mahajan, Vedita Singh
pmc-12630996.description: This case report highlights a rare incidence of acute angioedema triggered by an etchant during orthodontic treatment. It underscores the potential for commonly used dental materials to provoke allergic reactions. A 14-year-old female patient developed lip swelling, burning sensation, and localized pain shortly after etching.

pmc-13096120.title: Preventing subsoil enhanced nitrification to safeguard agroecosystem sustainability
pmc-13096120.creator: Yao Wang, Xin Luo, Esteban G. Jobbágy, Nandita B. Basu, Ganlin Zhang, Yi Zheng, Baojing Gu, Shaoliang Zhang, Yiqi Yu, Fenfang Wang, Zeyang Lu, Ruifeng Yan, Scott X. Chang, Yonglong Lu, Nengwang Chen
pmc-13096120.description: The excessive application of nitrogen fertilizers in croplands drives nitrification-induced nitrogen losses, accelerating soil degradation and groundwater nitrate pollution. By synthesizing global nitrogen profiles and field studies, we identify a previously overlooked “enhanced nitrification layer (ENL)” at approximately 0.6 m depth (ranging from 0.3 to 0.9 m) across global croplands.

pmc-13402217.title: Photoreforming Hydrogen From Polystyrene, Low‐Density Polyethylene, and High‐Density Polyethylene Microplastics via UV‐Driven Photolysis and TiO2‐Based Photocatalysis
pmc-13402217.creator: Miroslava Filip Edelmannová, Petr Praus, Lenka Řeháčková, Rudolf Ricka, Michal Ritz, Kamila Kočí
pmc-13402217.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study investigated UV‐induced photolysis and photocatalysis in the presence of TiO2 (Evonik P25) as methods for producing hydrogen from polystyrene (PS), low‐density polyethylene (LDPE), and high‐density polyethylene (HDPE) microplastics. Photolysis showed a strong dependence of reactivity on polymer structure, especially the one‐type LDPE microplastics, exhibiting the highest hydrogen production, while PS showed the lowest activity due to the stability of its aromatic backbone.

pmc-13624084.title: Evaluating large language models for domain-specific scholarly metadata classification
pmc-13624084.creator: Muhammad Haris, Maryam Badar
pmc-13624084.description: IntroductionLarge language models (LLMs) have been widely applied to text classification; however, their effectiveness in domain-specific scholarly metadata classification remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the use of open-source LLMs to classify modeling and simulation research articles across three predefined metadata dimensions: Industry, Application Area, and Modeling Method.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2000c5.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2000c–5 — Payments; adjustments; advances or reimbursement; installments
uslaw-usc-t42-s2000c5.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2000c5.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 21 (Civil Rights); Subchapter IV (Public Education). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Payments pursuant to a grant or contract under this subchapter may be made (after necessary adjustments on account of previously made overpayments or underpayments) in advance or by way of reimbursement, and in such installments, as the Secretary may.
